description: Training content will be localised and made available in Marathi, Hindi and English to ensure wider accessibility and effective implementation across the state's diverse school ecosystem - EducationTimes.com
body_lead: In a major push towards integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into school education, the Maharashtra School Education Department has signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) with Google for Education to provide AI and digital technology training to more than four lakh teachers across the state over the next 18 months. The initiative aims to equip teachers with future-ready digital competencies and promote the adoption of AI-enabled teaching practices in classrooms. It will focus on strengthening AI literacy, digital skills and technology-enabled pedagogy among educators.
